reader.requirement: At --std 85 an alphanumeric function-identifier is accepted wherever a sending identifier is permitted (conditions, EVALUATE, INSPECT TALLYING subject, STRING/UNSTRING senders and delimiters, INSPECT REPLACING/CONVERTING operands, WRITE FROM, function arguments, with reference modification), and refused (a) as any receiving operand and (b) where the position requires characteristics its result lacks (a numeric operand, an integer pointer).

reader.notes: Exception a is structural (no receiving grammar position admits FUNCTION) plus InspectBinder's format 2/3/4 screen; exception b is the operand-class screens. Side lead, not this rule: COBOL1632 and READ's COBOL0864 print the operand as glued token text (FUNCTIONUPPER-CASE(A1), DTOFIXR); no kb/Work note found for it.

BEFORE INITIAL function (IB 002), EVALUATE WHEN object, PERFORM UNTIL condition, CALL FUNCTION UPPER-CASE(NM) as identifier-1 (CALLED) and CANCEL all accepted with the defined values.
